description: Replace the content of an unpaid checkout session (other trip, number of motorcycles, riders, buyer). Send the whole checkout again, as for create_checkout.

checkout.description: UCP checkout (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout). One line: the scheduled trip and the number of motorcycles.

buyer.description: Optional: pre-fills the booking page (the customer can change it).

id.description: "trip_<id>" with the id of a trip returned by search_routes, e.g. "trip_1234".

from.description: Stop where the motorcycles are loaded (default: first stop of the trip).

motorcycles.description: Optional models, pre-filled on the booking page.

riders.description: People travelling with their motorcycles (default 0 = motorcycles only, max 3 per motorcycle).

to.description: Stop where they are delivered (default: last stop).

id.description: Checkout session id returned by create_checkout ("chk_…").

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata: {"ucp-agent": {"profile": "https://…/.well-known/ucp"}, "idempotency-key": "<uuid>"}. Send an idempotency key to retry safely.

name: update_checkout
title: Change a prepared booking
